basics.name: Sergio Andrés Barbosa
basics.label: AI/ML Engineer
basics.summary: I am passionate about intelligent systems and the intersection of AI and Quantum Computing. My research focuses on leveraging quantum principles to enhance AI, particularly in conversational agents and NLP. With a background in Computer Science, I have worked on AI-driven systems applied to oncology, business, and social impact, aiming to address challenges with high societal impact.

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: Developed technological solutions based on AI and NLP algorithms
highlights: Develop and implement AI and NLP algorithms to assess data quality, establishing quality criteria for the open data published on the portal of the Ministry of Information Technologies and Communications of Colombia. Skills include working with language large models, deep learning and data science.

Successfully adapted and deployed a Named Entity Recognition (NER) model pre-trained in the social context of victims and the armed conflict in Colombia, improving the accuracy and understanding of narratives surrounding this complex socio-political landscape. Skills include working with pre-trained NER models, Transformer Language Models (TLMs), integrated DL models, implementing ML models, and data science.

publications.name: Detection of Hate Speech, Racism and Misogyny in Digital Social Networks: Colombian
publications.summary: The main contribution of this work is the finetuning of a model using a proprietary dataset extracted from social networks, georeferenced in Colombia, and manually labelled with typical and dialect specific features. Indeed, the experiment compares the performance of TLM models adjusted to the Colombian slang domain against a GPT, having a significant impact on achieving more accurate predictions in this task.
